lines.speaker: perimeter_scav
lines.text: Service line. Parts on the ground, nobody allocated to pick them up, and a patrol that has flown the same circuit for eighty years.

lines.speaker: perimeter_scav
lines.text: I am not stealing. You cannot steal a thing that is not on any list. I have thought about this a great deal out here.

lines.speaker: perimeter_scav
lines.text: There is a plaque at the service gate with four hundred and six names on it. I read it every shift. I have no idea who any of them are.

lines.speaker: perimeter_scav
lines.text: Somebody put the fields on a public register. Half the parts out here have a name on them now and I do not know how I feel about it.
